name: compact-plus
description: Better compaction: a searchable history file, handoff-style summary instructions, your messages kept word for word, fresh instruction files, and compaction at turn end while you read.

turnEndPercent.title: Compact at turn end from (% of the auto-compact threshold)
turnEndPercent.description: When a turn ends with the context at or past this share of the auto-compact threshold, compact right away, while you read the reply. 0 turns it off.

verbatimUserTokens.title: Tokens of your own messages kept word for word
verbatimUserTokens.description: Your messages, newest first, appended verbatim to each compaction summary and carried across compactions. 0 turns it off.
